glosses: To determine, estimate or judge the value of; to evaluate; to estimate.

examples.text: An insurance adjuster will assess the damage.

glosses: To impose or charge, especially as punishment for an infraction.

examples.text: The referee assessed a penalty for delaying the game.
A $10.00 late fee will be assessed on all overdue accounts.

Judge Cohen ruled that Blacklock, McKenzie and Benschop must make restitution for the $50.29 damage and that each must pay a mandatory $40.00 surcharge assessed to anybody who is found guilty of a misdemeanor in New York state.

glosses: To calculate and demand (the tax money due) from a person or entity.

examples.text: Once you've submitted a tax return, the Tax Department will assess the amount of tax you still owe.
